create.title: Arithmetic pruning and strict exponent-pair range for the D=1 square-root wave
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), 1<<M<=R^2, and retain the literal zero-extended Round-148 profile A_U and the external coefficient B_(1,U)(1). For P_U=sum_(ell>0 odd) chi_4(ell)ell^(-3/4)A_U(ell)e(sqrt(Nell)), let k(ell) be the unique nearest integer to sqrt(Nell), j=k^2-Nell, and write uniquely ell=tau s^2 with tau odd squarefree and s odd. In the disjoint order L_0={j=0}, L_1={0<|j|<=M^(3/4)}, L_2={|j|>M^(3/4),s>=ceil(M^(1/4))}, and L_*={|j|>M^(3/4),s<ceil(M^(1/4))}, the first three weighted sums have total size O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The proof uses the exact-square ray, the all-parity bound rho_N(j)<=4*2^omega(N)*sqrt((|j|,N)), its O_epsilon(JX^epsilon) sum for 1<=|j|<=J, the k-support length O(sqrt(NM))<N, and the O(M^(3/4)) large-square-factor count. Hence P_U=P_U^*+O_epsilon(X^epsilon), where P_U^* is exactly the L_* sum, tau>>M^(1/2), and the s=1 layer remains. Independently, Tao--Trudgian--Yang's source-legal D and B processes applied to Bourgain's pair give D(13/84,55/84)=(18/199,593/796), BD(13/84,55/84)=(195/796,235/398), and |P_U|<<_epsilon(R^780/M^449)^(1/1592)X^epsilon. Thus M^449>>R^780 is target-safe and strictly extends the older M^819>>R^1424 scalar range because 780/449<1424/819. Below the new boundary the estimate |P_U^*|<<X^epsilon remains open. This is only the actual D=d=L=1, t=1 scalar and proves no D>1, L>1, generic, t>=2, cross-owner, full M1, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, target, or global-exponent statement.
create.next_action: Prove |P_U^*|<<X^epsilon below M^449 asymp R^780 while retaining the actual profile and the compulsory s=1 squarefree-kernel layer, or isolate the next strict owner-complete range.

create.title: Character loss and transform self-return below the strict square-root-wave range
create.statement_tex: For the literal D=d=L=1 square-root wave, adjacent odd pairing is an exact oscillatory finite difference whose phase increment can approach an integer and cannot be replaced by differentiation of the smooth weight. Every legal A-process uses an even shift 2h and satisfies chi_4(ell+2h)chi_4(ell)=(-1)^h, erasing the variable character. One A-process followed by the second-derivative test gives |P_U|^2<<_epsilon{M^(1/2)/H+R M^(-3/4)H^(1/2)+R^(-1)M^(3/4)H^(-1/2)}X^epsilon and gives no point below M asymp R^2. Mellin inversion has spectral scale sqrt(NM), root number +1, and unbalanced dual length sqrt(N/M); using the oscillatory kernel reproduces exact character Poisson and the accepted reciprocal row, while a second principal B-process returns the phase and principal symbol. The exact audited exponent-pair envelope reaches the target at M=R^(780/449); below it the printed Table-1 line is above the required beta line. Mixed Burgess, higher Voronoi, and fixed-parameter nonlinear-resonance sources do not directly match the coefficient, square-root phase, growing parameter, actual profile, or endpoint class. These are method-specific no-gain and no-match statements, not a signed lower bound or a literature-impossibility theorem. After arithmetic pruning, the first survivor is P_U^* below M^449 asymp R^780.

The all-parity quadratic-root count and the sub-N k interval give only O_epsilon(M^(3/4)X^epsilon) terms for 0<|j|<=M^(3/4), whose weighted mass is target-safe.
The disjoint s>=ceil(M^(1/4)) sector has O(M^(3/4)) supported terms and therefore target-safe actual-weight mass.

The audited sources fail the literal fixed-modulus square-root phase, coefficient class, growing-parameter uniformity, actual-profile, or endpoint hypotheses and provide only direct no-matches.
